answer: PoA derives trust from an EigenTrust-style factorization of normalized, reciprocity-weighted endorsements and applies exponential decay with a fixed half-life, so credibility requires sustained honest service. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot bridge into consensus by creating peers; a fable-like endorsement chain or ferrous-looking identity adds no weight without durable reciprocal evidence.
